description: This file contains test fixture code for unit testing the WebAudioPlayerService component. It sets up mock objects, expectations, and helper methods to facilitate testing various functionalities of WebAudioPlayerService, such as creating, destroying, playing, pausing, and configuring WebAudioPlayer instances.
